text:
mel: Quick heads-up — found mismatch in dashboard sample for prefetch KPI.
jasper: Which page? link?
mel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/console/dashboards/prefetch.md (line ~42) — metric name is `prefetch_latency_ms` in prod but the snippet uses `prefetch_latency` so the widget returns empty.
kim: good catch. did our docs tests pick that up?
mel: nope. local render shows widget but Prometheus queries fail. snippet currently:
```
- metric: prefetch_latency
  aggregator: p95
```
should be:
```
- metric: prefetch_latency_ms
  aggregator: p95
```
jasper: can you open a PR? I can review and help with backports.
mel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — fixes node/python snippets and markdown sample.
deploy-bot: docs deploy queued for staging (build #3421)
kim: also spotted the SDK sample in `examples/telemetry/node.js` — variable `latencyMetric = 'prefetch_latency'` needs updating.
mel: adding that to the PR.
jasper: while you're at it, add a one-line migration note: "metric names now include units (ms)" so platform teams know.
mel: done. pushed update. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: docs linter: trailing whitespace flagged in `prefetch.md` line 33.
mel: fixed whitespace and pushed again.
jasper: LGTM, tests passed on staging preview — numbers align with observability dashboard. merging.
mel: merged and backport PR opened against `v1.2`.
kim: thanks all. can someone create a small changelog blurb for the release notes?
mel: uploaded blurb to the release draft.
jasper: cherry-pick landed to `v1.2`, backport PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428
mel: great, closing thread.
